c.s: A classic cylinder heavy bag, designed with you in a personalised design consultation and built by hand. Choose the length, panel layout, colours, stitching, branding method, hanging hardware and extras in the configurator, and see it change as you go.
4-point chain with swivel (standard), heavy-duty swivel or strap hang
Silicone screen print (standard), embroidered patch, leather patch, debossed leather (leather only)

c.n: Can you put my gym's logo on it?
c.s: Can you put my gym's logo on it?

c.n: Yes. Upload it in the configurat
c.s: Yes. Upload it in the configurator. SVG or vector files are best; raster files should be at least 2000px wide. Choose silicone screen print, an embroidered patch, a leather patch or, on leather bags, debossing.

c.n: Export orders ship unfilled by d
c.s: Export orders ship unfilled by default and are filled on site. Australian and local deliveries can be filled.
